verses.text: Benedicta Ward’s translation of the Sayings of the Desert Fathers attributes a saying by Abba Agathon to Psalm 7:2: “if truly ye say that which is right, judge righteously, sons of men.” However, this seems to me a missattribution from what is Psalm 58:1 in the King James Version (or Psalm 57:2 in the Douay-Rheims Bible).
